design_specification.product_behavior: Collapsible from a rigid brief into a thin, roll-like folder; the central tube provides structural support.
design_specification.silhouette_form: Slim, tall rectangular prism with sharp square corners.
uncertainty_limitations: Core tube must be strong enough to prevent collapse when panels are fully extended.
